# Sample Skill

This is a fake skill used in tests. Its purpose is purely to exist on disk
so that the scanner has something to find.

It contains a few paragraphs of placeholder content to give it a non-trivial
token cost — enough that the scanner produces a measurable value, but not
so much that the test fixture becomes unwieldy.
